about: Old-save acceptance fixtures (Assets/Plans/OLD-SAVE-ACCEPTANCE.md). An episode fixture is a real save, byte for byte, or a save its schema's own build generated; each has the command script and season digest its reference build recorded. referenceInput, where present, says what the reference build was given instead of the save as written (schema 22's earlier shapes: the two literals the migration writes), and referenceInputSha256 is that file's hash. stateDigest and textDigest are the current build's, pinned. A fixture saved at the final speeches or after the finale is read, never counted as its cell's replay. source names where a real file came from; nothing reads it. refused lists saves the current build refuses on purpose, each with its reason.
